# NepsenX

NepsenX is an independent unregistered technology company based in Bangladesh focused on SaaS platforms, artificial intelligence, digital infrastructure, virtual systems, and next-generation internet experiences.

The company was founded by:
- Arafat Islam Lam (CEO, 50% Shareholder)
- MD. Shawon Choudhory (Co-Founder, 50% Shareholder)

NepsenX develops interconnected products designed to combine AI, automation, communication, education, marketing, entertainment, and digital services into a unified ecosystem.

Mission:
To build a bridge between human intent and machine intelligence through scalable, intelligent, and accessible technologies.

Website:
https://nepsenx.us.ci

Contact:
nepsenx@gmail.com


# Core Products

## Oracus AI
Website:
https://oracus.pages.dev

Oracus AI is an adaptive AI platform enhanced by NepsenX using modified open-source technologies.

The system focuses on:
- Agentic AI workflows
- Adaptive learning
- Intelligent automation
- Virtual task execution
- Browser-assisted AI interaction
- Virtual environment operation

Oracus AI can operate through virtual browsers and controlled virtual computing environments to perform advanced automated tasks.

Premium versions can unlock:
- Virtual browser access
- Advanced autonomous workflows
- Virtual PC interaction environments

The platform acts as the central intelligence layer across multiple NepsenX services.


## Adupter
Website:
https://adupter.nepsenx.us.ci

Adupter is an AI-powered marketing and campaign automation platform.

Core features:
- Automated advertisement generation
- Multi-platform campaign publishing
- AI-assisted marketing workflows
- Business support systems
- Customer engagement automation

Plans:
- AIR (Free)
- Moon ($9.99/month)
- Earth ($29.99/month)


## CG
Website:
https://cg-nepsenx.us.ci

CG is a cloud gaming platform designed for accessible and high-performance gaming experiences.

Core features:
- Cloud gaming access
- Low-latency gameplay
- Hardware-independent gaming
- Multiplayer and clan systems
- Scalable gaming infrastructure


## OpenA
Website:
https://opena.nepsenx.us.ci

OpenA is a decentralized multi-service platform combining:
- Social networking
- Intelligent search
- Commerce systems
- Content discovery
- Community interaction
- AI-assisted services

The platform is designed as an integrated ecosystem for communication, productivity, and online services.


## Basikno
Website:
https://basikno.nepsenx.us.ci

Basikno is an immersive e-learning platform focused on global education and AI-assisted learning experiences.

Core features:
- Interactive education systems
- AI tutoring assistance
- 3D learning environments
- Collaborative digital classrooms
- Adaptive learning experiences


## Ishahi
Website:
https://ishahi.pages.dev

Ishahi is an Islamic digital platform designed for Muslim communities worldwide.

Core features:
- Prayer schedules
- Ramadan timing
- Islamic calendar systems
- Community interaction
- Islamic live content
- AI-assisted support tools


## VirtuBrowse
Website:
https://virtubrowse.pages.dev

VirtuBrowse is a privacy-focused virtual browsing platform.

Core features:
- Secure browsing environments
- Virtual browsing isolation
- Privacy-oriented architecture
- Lightweight browsing systems
- Advanced web interaction tools


# Universal Membership System

NepsenX products support a connected membership ecosystem called Universal Pack.

Universal Packs provide cross-platform premium access across supported NepsenX services.

## Universal AIR
Free access tier across supported services.

Included:
- Adupter AIR
- Oracus AIR
- Universal AIR access

## Satellite
First premium universal tier.

Provides:
- First premium access across supported services
- 10% bundled discount

Included examples:
- Adupter Moon
- Oracus Titan

Pricing:
Combined premium pricing × 0.9

Seasonal Discounts:
During Ramadan and Eid events, discounts may increase to 30%.


## SolarSystem
Highest universal premium tier.

Provides:
- Advanced premium access across supported services
- Extended AI and automation capabilities
- 10% bundled discount

Included examples:
- Adupter Earth
- Oracus Saturn

Pricing:
Combined premium pricing × 0.9

Seasonal Discounts:
During Ramadan and Eid events, discounts may increase to 30%.


# Infrastructure Philosophy

NepsenX products are designed around distributed, virtualized, and scalable digital architectures.

The ecosystem focuses on:
- Efficient resource usage
- Virtualized environments
- AI-assisted automation
- Hybrid cloud interaction
- Localized user experiences
- Scalable intelligent systems


# Vision

NepsenX aims to create a connected ecosystem where AI, SaaS, communication, education, entertainment, and digital services work together seamlessly.

The long-term vision includes expansion into advanced AI-powered hardware, intelligent environments, virtual systems, and future digital infrastructure technologies.
